site.name: Hundavænt
meta.description: Find trusted information about dog-friendly places in the capital region.
about.metaDescription: Our story and the idea behind Hundavænt: helping people find welcoming places to enjoy with their dogs.
about.heroLede: Whenever we made plans with Miles, we found ourselves asking the same question many dog-owners face: would he be able to join us?
about.heroStory: We got Miles in 2019, just before the pandemic. By the time life opened up again, he was a large part of our family, and naturally we wanted him to be part of our outings too. But places that are dog-friendly are not as easy to find as they should be.
about.photoAlt: Vic holding Miles, a long-haired dachshund
about.problemTitle: The information is there but it's difficult to find online.
about.problemBodyOne: A place could be wonderfully welcoming to dogs and never say so online. Another might have conditions you would only discover at the door. Maps could show us a dog park, but not whether it was accessible, well-maintained and safe.
about.problemBodyTwo: That is why I built Hundavænt, so dog owners like myself can make plans with confidence and share with others what they learn along the way.
about.historyTitle: Reykjavík has made more room for dogs.
about.historyIntro: Change has come gradually and every place still sets its own rules. But more doors are opening, and the places making a genuine effort deserve to be shared and found.
about.history1924Body: For most of the twentieth century, keeping a dog in the city was prohibited.
about.history1984Body: Residents could apply for an exemption to keep a dog, though restrictions remained. Later in the decade, dogs were still banned from streets such as Laugavegur.
about.historyTodayBody: Today, more of the city includes dogs in everyday life. They can travel on Strætó outside weekday rush hours, and small dogs are welcome in Kringlan every day with a few exceptions.
about.offersTitle: Find places where you can both feel welcome.
about.offersIntro: Hundavænt can help you understand both sides of a visit: the rules a place sets and how welcoming it felt to people who have been there before.
about.offerDiscoverBody: Explore nearby cafés, restaurants, parks, and shops, then narrow the map to the places that suit you and your dog.
about.offerAccessBody: See where your dog can join you, whether a leash is needed, whether you should ask first, and anything else worth knowing before you arrive.
about.offerRememberTitle: Keep the places you care about
about.offerRememberBody: Favorite places you want to return to, keep a private record of your visits, and share how welcome you and your dog felt.
about.offerContributeBody: Help keep Hundavænt useful by adding missing places, correcting outdated details, and letting us know when something seems wrong!
about.trustTitle: Clear details and real experiences, side by side.
about.trustIntro: Know what to expect before you arrive, learn from dog owners who have been there, and let us know when something changes.
about.accessBody: See where your dog can join you and what you need to know before arriving, so you can choose a place that works for both of you.
about.friendlinessBody: Ratings come from real visits from people like you. They reflect how welcome and comfortable people felt with their dogs, how clear the rules were, and how much care the place showed. They add another perspective without changing the practical details.
about.visionTitle: The capital region first. Maybe the rest of Iceland next?
about.visionBodyOne: Hundavænt is available close to our home, in the capital region, where I can verify and keep this up-to-date. If people find it useful and want to help, my hope is that we can grow it across Iceland together.
about.visionBodyTwo: One day, Hundavænt might help dog owners connect more directly. For now, the community grows each time someone explores the map, shares a place, or helps improve what is already there.

legal.termsIntro: Hundavænt helps you find and share information about places where dogs are welcome.
legal.termsBody: Use the service thoughtfully and share only information you believe is accurate. We may remove content or access that harms the service or other people.
legal.privacyIntro: We collect only the information needed to operate Hundavænt and keep your private actions connected to you.
legal.privacyBody: Your email and sign-in identities stay private. Favorites, private rating notes, authentication details, and weekly-recap settings are never shown publicly. Recap municipalities, place types, language, and future email interest are used only to prepare your private in-product recap and are never inferred from your activity.
